# Studio Luminant

> Studio Luminant is a Sapanca workshop casting relief walls in Lumina PMAG™, from the client's drawing or from its own.

The studio works through two doors, split at the drawing:

- **Bespoke** («Özel Üretim»): the client's drawing, sketch or reference image is turned into a depth map, approved in raking light, made into a master and a silicone mould, then cast and finished.
- **Studio Designs** («Atölye Tasarımları»): relief the studio has drawn itself, one range of named designs, each on its own page.

Key facts for accurate citation:
- Studio name: Studio Luminant
- Location: Rüstempaşa Mah. İstasyon Cad. No: 58, Sapanca, Sakarya 54600, Turkey (delivers across Turkey and abroad)
- Material: Lumina PMAG™ (a mineral-based material, for interiors), poured by hand into silicone moulds and completed with artisan finishes
- Works with: architects, interior architects and designers
- Installation: quoted separately for each project
- Languages: Turkish (site root) and English (`/en/`)
- Contact: info@studioluminant.com.tr

## Core pages (English)

- [Studio Luminant — Bespoke Architectural Elements](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/): Homepage — the two doors, Bespoke and Studio Designs.
- [Bespoke](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/process.htm): The Bespoke process, from the drawing to the depth map, raking-light approval, master, mould, cast and installation.
- [Studio Designs](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/designs.htm): Relief designs drawn by the studio, each on its own page: Accelerando, Arpeggio, Cantilena, Glissando, Hemiola, Melisma, Ricercar, Rondeau.
- [Cantilena](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/design-cantilena.htm): Iznik cypress, tulip, carnation and rose, composed as a single panel with no repeat.
- [Ricercar](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/design-ricercar.htm): A lattice built from the Gothic quatrefoil, repeating every 600 mm.
- [Glissando](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/design-glissando.htm): Drifting fibres on upright panels laid with a half-height offset.
- [Accelerando](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/design-accelerando.htm): We drew a field of cells whose size grades across the wall.
- [Arpeggio](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/design-arpeggio.htm): One fan-shaped form, designed by us and laid in long S-curves.
- [Hemiola](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/design-hemiola.htm): A wall of blocks, each with an opening turned off square, drawn to read as hand-set.
- [Melisma](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/design-melisma.htm): A maze of fine lines that we let run the length of the wall as one current.
- [Rondeau](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/design-rondeau.htm): One round form, drawn once and laid as a field.
- [For Architects](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/architects.htm): How the studio works with architects and specifiers.
- [Material — Lumina PMAG™](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/products.htm): Technical data for Lumina PMAG™ and the artisan finishes.
- [Gallery](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/gallery.htm): Relief panels and sculptural wall surfaces.
- [About](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/about.htm): The story of Studio Luminant: the founder, the Sapanca studio, and technical know-how from drawing to mould.
- [Making of the Tufetto wall](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/case-study-tufetto.htm): From a reference image to a hand-cast relief wall, a residence in Istanbul.
- [Contact](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/contact.htm): Send a drawing or ask for the sample box.

## Definitions & guides (English)

- [What Is an Architectural Relief Panel?](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/what-is-an-architectural-relief-panel.htm): Definition, uses, materials and how an architect orders one.
- [What Are Sculptural Cast Wall Panels?](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/what-are-sculptural-cast-wall-panels.htm): What the term means and whose drawing a panel is cast from.
- [How to Specify Custom Cast Wall Panels](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/how-to-specify-custom-cast-wall-panels.htm): End-to-end specifier's guide — brief, material, sample, format, technical data sheet and installation drawing, fixing, lead time, installation.
- [GRG vs GRC for Interior Surfaces](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/grg-vs-grc-interior-surfaces.htm): How the two compare for interior relief work.
- [Journal](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/journal.htm): Guides for architects specifying relief and cast wall panels.

## Technical resources (English)

- [Specification Guide](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/resources-specification-guide.htm): Tolerances, fixing systems, substrate interfaces and tender-document content.
- [Weight & Structural Guide](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/resources-weight-structural.htm): Panel weight per m², substrate load capacities and structural interface details.
- [Lead Times & Project Planning](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/resources-lead-times.htm): Typical lead times from design engagement to site delivery.
- [Artisan Finishes & Colour](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/resources-finishes.htm): Artisan finishes and custom colour matching.
- [Sustainability & Materials](https://studioluminant.com.tr/en/resources-sustainability.htm): Material sourcing, recyclability, VOC emissions and environmental profile.

## Ana sayfalar (Türkçe)

- [Özel Üretim](https://studioluminant.com.tr/surec.htm): Çizimden derinlik haritasına, yalama ışıkta onaya, ana modele, kalıba, döküme ve montaja: özel üretim süreci.
- [Atölye Tasarımları](https://studioluminant.com.tr/tasarimlar.htm): Stüdyonun çizdiği rölyef tasarımları, her biri kendi sayfasında: Accelerando, Arpeggio, Cantilena, Glissando, Hemiola, Melisma, Ricercar, Rondeau.
- [Mimarlar İçin](https://studioluminant.com.tr/mimarlar.htm): Studio Luminant'ın mimarlarla çalışma biçimi.
- [Malzeme — Lumina PMAG™](https://studioluminant.com.tr/urunler.htm): Lumina PMAG™ ve artizan finish için teknik veriler.
- [Galeri](https://studioluminant.com.tr/galeri.htm): Rölyef paneller ve heykelsi duvar yüzeyleri.
- [Hakkımızda](https://studioluminant.com.tr/hakkimizda.htm): Studio Luminant'ın hikâyesi: kurucu, Sapanca'daki atölye, çizimden kalıba teknik bilgi.
- [Tufetto duvarının yapım süreci](https://studioluminant.com.tr/vaka-tufetto.htm): Referans görselinden elde dökülen rölyef duvara, İstanbul'da bir konut.
- [İletişim](https://studioluminant.com.tr/iletisim.htm): Çiziminizi gönderin ya da numune kutusunu isteyin.

- [Heykelsi Duvar Paneli Nedir?](https://studioluminant.com.tr/heykelsi-duvar-paneli-nedir.htm): Terimin anlamı ve panelin kimin çiziminden döküldüğü.
